title: Support for websockets >= 17.x
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

I am unable to upgrade to Streamlit 1.64.0 because it enforces a strict upper bound on the websockets package (<17). My project requires websockets>=17.1, causing pip dependency resolution to fail.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python

```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Create a virtual environment.
2. Attempt to install both packages via pip by running:
`pip install streamlit==1.64.0 "websockets>=17.1"`

### Expected Behavior

_No response_

### Current Behavior

The conflict is caused by:
    The user requested websockets>=17.1
    streamlit 1.64.0 depends on websockets<17 and >=12.0.0

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

* Streamlit version: 1.64.0
* Python version: 3.10
* Operating System: Windows
* Package manager: pip

### Additional Information

The `websockets` package recently released version 17.x. Bumping the upper bound constraint in Streamlit's dependencies would prevent installation blocks for projects relying on modern websockets versions.
